title: dactylorhiza kerryensis var. occidentalis
intro: Dactylorhiza kerryensis var. occidentalis, commonly known as Kerry marsh orchid, is a rare, terrestrial orchid species native to Ireland. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wound healing, anti-aging, and antiviral activities. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza kerryensis var. occidentalis include vasodilation, which can help in improving circulation and reducing blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
